lean.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hnd : n ≤ d)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ)
    (Os : Fin (d / n) → Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ),
    let e : ((Fin n × Fin (d / n)) ⊕ Fin (d % n)) ≃ Fin d :=
      ((Equiv.sumCongr
        ((Equiv.prodComm (Fin n) (Fin (d / n))).trans finProdFinEquiv)
        (Equiv.refl (Fin (d % n)))).trans finSumFinEquiv).trans
        (finCongr (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_add_mod d n))
    let B : Fin (d / n) → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := fun j =>
      ((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) -
        ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((Os j : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) +
          (Os j : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)
    let A := Matrix.reindex e e
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.blockDiagonal B) 0 0
        (1 : Matrix (Fin (d % n)) (Fin (d % n)) ℝ))
    let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x =>
      (WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x) / 2
    let query : Fin (d / n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Bool →
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := fun j v inverse =>
      WithLp.toLp 2 (if inverse then
        (Os j : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp v
      else (Os j : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp v)
    let xb : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → Fin (d / n) →
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := fun x j =>
      WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => x (e (Sum.inl (i, j))))
    let gb : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → Fin (d / n) →
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := fun x j =>
      ((κ + 1) / 2) • xb x j - ((κ - 1) / 4) •
        (query j (xb x j) false + query j (xb x j) true)
    let g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) := fun x =>
      WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a => Sum.elim
        (fun ij => gb x ij.2 ij.1)
        (fun i => x (e (Sum.inr i))) (e.symm a))
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      HasGradientAt f (g x) x ∧
      (f x, gradient f x) = (inner ℝ x (g x) / 2, g x)
approved_definition_context: EuclideanSpace real (Fin m) is the real m-dimensional inner product space with the l2 norm. Fin m indexes coordinates from zero. WithLp.toLp 2 and WithLp.ofLp preserve entries; inner real is the ordinary real Euclidean inner product.

Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) real is the full group of real orthogonal matrices, containing either determinant sign. A matrix coerced from this group has inverse equal to its transpose. Matrix multiplication by a vector and the dot product are finite sums.

Matrix.reindex e e M has entries M (e.symm i) (e.symm j). Matrix.blockDiagonal B is indexed by pairs (local coordinate, block index) and vanishes between distinct blocks. Matrix.fromBlocks assembles its four displayed blocks. The symbol 1 denotes the identity matrix.

Equiv.prodComm exchanges the factors. finProdFinEquiv sends (a,b) to a times the cardinality of the second factor plus b. finSumFinEquiv concatenates the summands; finCongr transports along its displayed equality of cardinalities. Sum.elim selects the indicated branch.

HasGradientAt f v x means that f has a genuine Frechet derivative at x represented by the inner product with v. The operation gradient f x is totalized: it selects the derivative-representing vector when differentiability holds and otherwise returns zero. The displayed conjunction includes HasGradientAt as a conclusion; this context does not supply it as a premise.

Bool has the two values false and true; the displayed conditional chooses its first branch when true and its second branch when false. Scalar multiplication and real arithmetic have their usual meanings; natural division and remainder are floor division and remainder. A product equality asserts equality of both components.
